Messages.Author: bec...@aapt.net.au
Messages.Body:
Just a question regarding the eye of Hazimel. Athough it cannot be
moved, stolen etc, is it possible to use Reg Driscol's ability (if he
performs a successful equip action you may move the equipment to any
minion you control) to move the eye? I realise that by virtue of his
card text (the word "moved" may indicate that he cannot, but I am
unsure as to the timing. Does Reg equip, then pass the item on or does
he serve as a sort of "proxy equipper" and never has control of the
item in the first place? Any response would be apreciated.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He equips and then moves.
He cannot move the Eye while ready.

Messages.Author: sutekh_23
Messages.Body:


Thank you for clearing that up
